findings.summary: Because the listener units do not list /run/planeon/live-proxy, systemd does not open that directory for writing in their mount namespace. If W03 hardens the observer's unit with ProtectSystem=strict or a read-only /run, both the ExecStartPre= `rm -f` and the observer's bind would fail unless the unit names the directory in ReadWritePaths=. O-W03-OBSERVER-UNIT does not state this coupling.
findings.evidence: This is the reviewer's reading of systemd.exec(5); the research tree has no systemd material, and no network was used. Under ProtectSystem=strict, systemd mounts the file system read-only and opens for writing only the directories that unit's own RuntimeDirectory=, StateDirectory= and similar settings and ReadWritePaths= name. ExecStartPre= lines without the '+' prefix share the unit's sandbox (SOL4-6). No tracked contract file sets any of these options, so nothing published conflicts. The failure is safe: the bind fails, I01 stays down, and O-T04-HS53's start case would find it. Suggest one clause in O-W03-OBSERVER-UNIT: a listener unit that restricts the file system names /run/planeon/live-proxy in ReadWritePaths=.
